title: Dear Dincy
tagline: A handmade apology letter with nineteen little stamps to discover.
concept: It feels like opening a real handmade card. A sealed envelope opens, a handwritten apology rises out of it in the sender's own words, and the page turns to reveal nineteen postage stamps, each one a small thing that reminded him of her. Every stamp has to be opened before the letter can be closed, and only then does the signed thank-you appear.
features: Nineteen flip-to-reveal personal stamps with a progress counter
Ending unlocks only after every stamp is opened
tech: Static HTML/CSS/JS, hand-drawn SVG, Web Audio
